pirs.title: Russian extraterritorial military doctrine and Swedish response
pirs.collection_notes: Lithuanian Seimas recognition of Ichkeria (April 2026) provides new diplomatic precedent. FM Malmer Stenergard has not responded as of 2026-05-20. Swedish position increasingly an outlier in Baltic-Nordic context.
pirs.close_criteria: Swedish government issues formal position on Ichkeria recognition OR FM provides substantive diplomatic response

pirs.title: Sweden's policy on recognizing Russian-occupied territories
pirs.collection_notes: HD10494 is the primary collection document for this cycle. Questions posed by SD's Strandman are on the record. Three direct questions to FM on consistency with Ukraine recognition policy.
pirs.close_criteria: Government announces review of occupied-territory recognition framework OR explicitly maintains current policy with stated rationale

pirs.title: SD-M foreign policy differentiation dynamics in 2026 election campaign
pirs.collection_notes: Pattern confirmed: SD is using consecutive interpellation cycles to accumulate Russia-policy differentiation from M. HD10494 is the fourth consecutive cycle with Russia-adjacent interpellation. The dual-track SD strategy (foreign policy vs. KD economic pressure) is coherent and pre-election.
pirs.close_criteria: Election 2026-09-13 (closes automatically); or SD withdraws from Tidö cooperation

pirs.title: Implementation failure on care recipient gender-choice right
pirs.collection_notes: Court ruling found no enforceable right to gender choice for intimate care. 2022 Riksdag tillkännagivande to government not implemented. S's Isak From has now formally questioned minister. This is a new PIR opened this cycle.
pirs.close_criteria: Government introduces legislative initiative on care gender choice; or issue moves to committee for formal inquiry
